artifacts.summary: Single-phase plan: verify the research report against both DONE WHEN clauses, then write the completion summary carrying the drafted durability statement verbatim for the documentation record to place.

memory_candidates.content: For a research-only record whose report already discharges every DONE WHEN clause, the honest plan is one verify-and-summarize phase, not a manufactured multi-phase decomposition. The remaining work is attestation plus a completion summary that carries the drafted deliverable verbatim; a verification verdict and the summary recording it cannot usefully be committed apart, because a failed verification changes what the summary says rather than adding a second deliverable. Split only when a phase boundary separates two independently committable artifacts.
